hooks.command:
timeout --kill-after=1s 5s sh -c 'if root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && common=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); then /usr/bin/python3 "$common/hooks/workflow-policy-guard.py" hook --policy-root "$root" --expected-common-dir "$common" || printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Policy hook could not resolve or verify the session repository"}}'"'"'; else printf '"'"'%s
'"'"' '"'"'{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Policy hook could not resolve or verify the session repository"}}'"'"'; fi' || printf '%s
' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Policy verification failed or exceeded its time limit"}}'
